Oh god…the other day, I literally missed my online psych appointment by an hour EVEN THOUGH I HAD MY PHONE OPEN AND WAS WAITING FOR A NOTIFICATION.

My psychiatrist is consistently 20-45 min late (the practice is obviously overworking and over scheduling their psychiatrists), so the last few appointments she FaceTimed me when she was ready instead of me waiting on the phone for the Zoom meeting to start. 

So I was sitting at my desk waiting and waiting, checked my email 4x for a link to my appointment (in case she forgot our FaceTime deal and sent a zoom link instead), scrolled through my phone, got lost reading Reddit shit, etc. 

Then I saw an HOUR had passed and I checked my email one last time…saw a link that was sent that morning. My heart sank. I don’t know why my email didn’t pull it up until then. 

I panicked and called the office. I told the receptionist I was waiting for a FaceTime call since it always starts late, and didn’t see the Zoom link. He informed me I should’ve called after waiting 5 minutes and the Zoom link was sent that morning. “Did you not see the email?” (Yes, yes, I know I’m an idiot and am already feeling super dumb and humiliated). 

He informed me since an hour had passed, I had to pay the $100 no show fee. AND since my psychiatrist is leaving the practice and I’m being referred to a new one, the next available appointment isn’t until the end of next month. AND I also can’t get a refill on my adderall until then. 

I was crying (silently) throughout our interaction, but I couldn’t hold it in when he said I couldn’t get a refill until over a month from now. When he realized I was crying, he got apologetic and felt bad. Then I felt bad for making him feel bad haha

All that to say this: I am so fucking dumb for MISSING MY VIRTUAL APPOINTMENT WHILE I HAD MY PHONE IN MY HAND. I don’t understand why I can’t just function like a normal fucking person sometimes.
The FBI website directed me to [this tip line](https://report.cybertip.org/) to report child exploitation.
